 National Blue Alert Network
 History
 In 2015, Congress passed the Rafael Ramos and
 Wenjian Liu National Blue Alert Act, named in
 honor of two New York City police officers killed in
 an ambush attack on December 20, 2014. The Act
 establishes a voluntary nationwide system to give police
 an early warning of threats against police officers and
 to aid in the apprehension of suspects who have killed
 or seriously injured an officer. In 2016, the COPS
 Photo: 101cats/iStock
 Office was asked to implement the Blue Alert Act and
 establish a National Blue Alert Network.
